args.subject: Re: Refund request for a duplicate charge (Ticket #4711)
args.body:
Hello,

Thank you for contacting support regarding ticket #4711.

We have reviewed your account (Customer ID: 8812) and verified the duplicate charge. As the amount is under $200, your refund request has been automatically approved and processed.

Please allow a few business days for the refund to reflect on your statement. If you have any further questions or concerns, feel free to reply to this message.

Best regards,
Customer Support Team
